finalIntegrationPolicies.walkingAndInputs: Seven station floor owners, continuous stairs, distance-gated access actions,E/WASD/arrows,drag look; mobile joystick+interaction. Blur,cancel,visibility,input disable and disposal clear held input; editable controls do not trigger walking.
finalIntegrationPolicies.boarding: Actual loaded serviceLine,correct platform direction,exact stopped body pose and open-door aperture required; no alight,mode/minimap escape or teleport while moving.
finalIntegrationPolicies.transfer: Waterfront only. Alight,walk to access/concourse,change platforms,load/prewarm actual other-line train,then board.

trackProfile.horizontal: Broad C2 endpoint joins; retained GTFS source coordinates remain immutable. Two short nearly straight source edges use one quintic middle to avoid backtracking between representative pivots.
trackProfile.vertical: C2 representative grade/depression constrained by actual city terrain while retaining exact station stop positions/quaternions; not a surveyed engineering alignment.

articulatedTrain.pose: Each car samples its own physical arc distance; exact endpoint-tangent extrapolation. Occupied-car standing anchor/camera,interior and lights follow car0.
articulatedTrain.stationStop: Reset all car frames to exact linear authored offsets before physical platform proof and opening doors.
articulatedTrain.sharedResources: Expo single-car shell geometry is instanced4times per material;48metal/glass door pairs use identical articulated matrices. Canada reverse clone retains its original side mapping. Resources release exactly once.

finalIntegrationPolicies.stationApproachPreparation: After source owner hides and progress exceeds roughly15%,replace it with the single destination owner. Hold it hidden while asynchronous shader preparation runs,then show it before the uncovered approach. Only actual arrival updates station identity/stop pose; unfinished preparation holds closed. Reuse the exact prepared owner; guarded retry/disposal/generation prevents late reactivation.
finalIntegrationPolicies.shaderPreparation: Synchronously make the relevant subtree visible,call compileAsync(city.scene,camera) so each world/cabin/station light is counted once and city materials warm the matching lighting variant,then restore visibility before awaiting. Entry/line change remains busy until complete.

limitations: Representative original station interiors,depths,track joins and materials; not surveyed architecture,photogrammetry or engineering alignment.
Offline GTFS-derived regional route and gameplay timing; not live service or timetable.
Fixed standing cabin anchor; no free cabin walking,seat selection or intercar traversal.
Expo four-car MarkV-inspired service is not a complete real five-car MarkV reconstruction.
Finite CPU triangle/predicate tests do not establish GPU image quality,continuous collision proof,zero stutter or physical-phone performance.
